title: Paul McCartney live: Adopt-A-Minefield Gala, Los Angeles | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the fifth annual Adopt-A-Minefield Gala at the Beverly Hilton hotel in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 15 November 2005.

McCartney performed at the charity’s gala event each year from 2001 to 2005. Also on the bill on this night was Tony Bennett.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Fly Me To The Moon’ (snippet)
  • ‘Drive My Car’
  • ‘All My Loving’
  • ‘Whole Lotta Shakin’ Goin’ On’
  • ‘English Tea’
  • The Long and Winding Road
  • ‘Midnight Special’
  • ‘Things We Said Today’
  • ‘I’ll Follow The Sun’
  • ‘Penny Lane’
  • ‘Get Back’
  • ‘Let It Be’
  • ‘Lady Madonna’

Adopt-A-Minefield Gala appearances

  • 14 June 2001: Beverly Wilshire, Los Angeles, USA
  • 18 September 2002: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 23 September 2003: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 October 2004: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 November 2005: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
Page last updated: 7 March 2024

  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo

  • 1974: Recording: Rock Show by Wings
  • 1974: UK album release: Goodnight Vienna by Ringo Starr
  • 1973: Interview: John Lennon for Crawdaddy
  • 1972: Recording: Death Of Samantha, Is Winter Here To Stay?, I Have A Woman Inside My Soul by Yoko Ono
  • 1968: George Harrison appears on The Smothers Brothers Comedy Hour

  • 1963: The Beatles live: Colston Hall, Bristol
